items.evidence: Vanilla 1.21.11 loot tables: 1,324 files; functions lists in 361 files (983 occurrences); modifier in 0; condition objects use the string condition key (1,542 objects); blocks/diamond_ore.json confirms the format. Port items.rs: modifiers read from [modifier] only (:1870-1871, :2143, :2284); condition() reads o.get(type) only (:1988); modifiers() reads f[type].or(f[function]) (:2308) but is never handed the functions list. The 1.21.7 tree FIXED this (reads functions, condition reads type OR condition at :2126-2127); the 1.21.11 tree did not carry the fix. Blast radius measured fresh: 856/1,083 block tables (79%) have ALL pools conditioned, so those blocks drop NOTHING (crafter, chest, oak_log verified); diamond ore drops nothing via entry-level gating; shulker boxes drop without contents/name. The second engine (horizon-world loot.rs) reads singular pool[condition]/entry[condition] (:2028/:2080) and pool[modifier]/table[modifier] (:2039-2040), so entity/fishing/trial/vault loot is ungated instead. The port's own loot tests use 26.3-form fixtures, so the defect is invisible to its test suite. Blocks test_crafter_drop_name (NEW - corrects the 1.21.10 pass verdict) and test_loot_mine_pot_components (with G28).
items.method: jar data + source (1.21.10 re-check, reproduces; 1.21.7's fix NOT carried; upgraded to major on measured blast radius)
items.title: Loot engine reads 26.3 key names (modifier/type) instead of 1.21.11's (functions/condition)

systemic_note: The 1.21.11 template is a mixed inheritance, same as its 1.21.10 child. The 26.3-form component/tag-read pattern survives wholesale (providers.rs, brewing.rs, composter.rs, menu.rs, block_entity_nbt.rs, block_entity_item.rs, sign_edit.rs, dispenser.rs, spawner.rs, items.rs loot engine read cooking_fuel, brewing_fuel, compostable, sign_text_front/back, waxed, #extendable_maps - none of which exist in 1.21.11), so the four 1.21.7 majors are still live (G01 furnaces never light, G02 brewing never brews, G16 cartography dead, G30 composter dead) and a fifth major joins them (G26: 856/1,083 block tables drop nothing), and the 1.21.7 tree's fixes (FUEL_VALUES table, loot engine reading functions/condition) were NOT carried. But genuine 1.21.11 adaptations exist: furnace burns by 1 and resets its timer (G03, G06 fixed), sculk growth inhibition counts sensors/shriekers directly (G37 fixed), gamerules.rs is rewritten for the data-driven game_rule registry with a complete 59/59 table (G11 fixed, no name map needed), merchant gossip delivery is deferred to the villager AI phase and crafted counts drain into stats (both merchant drivers pass), furnace XP draws from the level random, and the smithing template list grows 9 -> 11. The oracle side improved in places: VanillaCommandExecOracle and VanillaLevelShapeOracle now pass, VanillaFurnaceOracle lost its own errors to the id() adaptation, and error counts fell sharply where the gamerules and gizmos packages now exist (Dispenser 42 -> 19, Sculk 51 -> 18, Trading 86 -> 23, BlockUpdate 63 -> 38, MobAi 103 -> 38) - but a new wrong adaptation appeared (ChunkPos.pack, which the jar does not have) and the 26.3-form causes (EntityTypes, ContainerInput, TradeCost, 11-arg ServerLevel ctor) still block 28 drivers.
